stage_note: Stages are 7-day spans from the first recorded visit, Sep 30.
clusters_note: Topics a patient abroad searches for before treatment in Turkey. A page belongs to a topic when its title or H1 contains one of the words. Three pages per language is full coverage.

subs.name: Named medical reviewer
subs.action: Name the reviewing doctor, with specialty and registration, on every treatment page.

subs.name: Clinic accreditation and licences
subs.action: Name each partner clinic's JCI or Ministry of Health accreditation on its treatment pages.

subs.name: Medical sources cited
subs.action: Cite a medical or official source on treatment and guide pages.

subs.name: Recovery and risks
subs.action: Give every procedure page its own recovery and risks sections.

subs.name: Authors, dates and credentials
subs.action: Add named authors and review dates to guides, and credentials to the About page.

subs.name: Procedures per treatment area
subs.action: Add procedure pages to treatment areas with fewer than five in any language.

subs.name: Coverage of patient searches
subs.action: Write pages for target searches that have no matching page yet.

subs.name: Depth and accuracy
subs.action: Add recovery timelines, costs and clinic details to thin pages.

subs.name: Prices on procedure pages
subs.action: Publish a from-price or price range on every procedure page.

subs.name: Freshness, dated facts
subs.action: Date and refresh prices and clinic facts each quarter.

subs.name: Patient tools and downloads
subs.action: Add a cost estimator or a pre-travel checklist.

subs.name: Answer-first passages
subs.action: Open each treatment page and guide with a two-sentence direct answer.

subs.name: Quotable facts with sources and dates
subs.action: Put the source and date next to every figure.

subs.name: Entity clarity
subs.action: State who, where and for whom in the first lines of key pages.

subs.name: AI crawler access
subs.action: Allow AI crawlers in robots.txt.

subs.name: llms.txt and machine-readable summaries
subs.action: Publish llms.txt summarising treatments, clinics and prices.

subs.name: Cited by AI assistants
subs.action: Publish short, dated answers to the top patient questions so AI assistants can cite them.

subs.name: Featured-snippet and FAQ-shaped content
subs.action: Answer common patient questions in short question-and-answer blocks.

subs.name: Crawl and robots
subs.action: Take the {noindex_pages} out of the sitemap and recheck robots.txt after each release.

subs.name: Sitemap completeness, lastmod, hreflang
subs.action: List the {missing_pages} missing from sitemap.xml, or noindex them.

subs.name: Status codes, redirects, 404
subs.action: Fix broken internal links and error pages.

subs.name: Canonicals
subs.action: Point every page's canonical to its own address.

subs.name: Indexation (live)
subs.action: Request indexing in Search Console for the {unknown_pages} not in Google yet.

subs.name: Page speed proxy
subs.action: Trim the slowest pages first: {slowest}.

subs.name: Mobile, HTTPS, basics
subs.action: Set a mobile viewport on every page and force HTTPS.

subs.name: Titles
subs.action: Rewrite titles that are missing, duplicated or outside 25 to 65 characters.

subs.name: Meta descriptions
subs.action: Rewrite descriptions outside 70 to 160 characters.

subs.name: H1 and heading structure
subs.action: Use exactly one H1 per page.

subs.name: Query-intent match to target searches
subs.action: Give each target search one page and use its wording in the title and H1.

subs.name: Internal linking and anchors
subs.action: Link to weakly linked pages from related pages.

subs.name: Image alt and share images
subs.action: Add share images to the {noshare_pages} without one.

subs.name: English search presence
subs.action: Strengthen the pages for target searches closest to showing.

subs.name: hreflang correctness and reciprocity
subs.action: Fix hreflang pairs that do not point back.

subs.name: German content parity
subs.action: Publish German versions of the {en_only_pages_de} that have none.

subs.name: Arabic content parity
subs.action: Publish Arabic versions of the {en_only_pages_ar} that have none.

subs.name: German metadata quality
subs.action: Write native German titles and descriptions, not translations.

subs.name: Arabic metadata quality
subs.action: Write native Arabic titles and descriptions, not translations.

subs.name: German search presence
subs.action: Use the German search wording in the titles of the German treatment pages.

subs.name: Arabic search presence
subs.action: Use the Arabic search wording in the titles of the Arabic treatment pages.

subs.name: Brand name consistency
subs.action: Use one brand name on the site, listings and profiles.

subs.name: Address, phone, authorisation
subs.action: Put the office address in the structured data and the health-tourism authorisation number in the footer.

subs.name: Google Business Profile and Maps
subs.action: Create and complete the Google Business Profile for the Istanbul office.

subs.name: sameAs and social profiles
subs.action: Link Instagram, Facebook and YouTube profiles to the site and back.

subs.name: Medical-travel directory listings
subs.action: List the service on medical-travel directories.

subs.name: Referring domains and backlinks
subs.action: Earn links from German and Gulf health and travel publications.

subs.name: Patient reviews (Google, Trustpilot)
subs.action: Ask each treated patient for a Google or Trustpilot review.

subs.name: Brand mentions
subs.action: Get named by partner clinics and patient communities.

subs.name: Coverage
subs.action: Add structured data to pages without it.

subs.name: Validity and match with visible content
subs.action: Check structured data against visible content in Google's Rich Results Test.

subs.name: Medical structured data
subs.action: Mark procedure pages up as MedicalProcedure inside a MedicalWebPage.

subs.name: Entity links (sameAs, @id graph)
subs.action: Add social and directory profiles to the Organization sameAs.

subs.name: Search Console and Bing verification
subs.action: Verify the site in Bing Webmaster Tools.

subs.name: IndexNow and sitemap ping
subs.action: Serve an IndexNow key file at the site root so Bing picks up changes.

subs.name: Analytics and conversion events
subs.action: Send generate_lead when a treatment enquiry is sent, and mark it as a key event.
